mapper.select:
/* isry.aimns.attendmgmt.atend.mapper.AtboYrPreconMapper.selectAtboPcList - [응용3팀] 이상훈 */
SELECT INST_NM --기관 , PVSN_RESRCE_NM --과정명 , TRPR_NM --대상자명 , TRPR_INFO_NO --대상자정보번호 , TRMN_SE_CD_NM --상태 , SUM(ATEND_TIMECNT) AS ATEND_TIMECNT --출석시수 , SUM(CLASS_TIMECNT) AS CLASS_TIMECNT --총수업시수 , CASE SUM(CLASS_TIMECNT) WHEN 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(SUM(ATEND_TIMECNT)/SUM(CLASS_TIMECNT)*10000)/100 END AS ATEND_RATE --출석률 FROM ( SELECT D.INST_NM --기관 , C.PVSN_RESRCE_NM --과정명 , DEC_B64(F.TRPR_NM_ENCPT) AS TRPR_NM --대상자명 , F.TRPR_INFO_NO --대상자정보번호 , (SELECT CMMNS_CD_VALUE_NM FROM SAC100 /*공통코드값*/ WHERE CMMNS_CD_ID = 'TRMN_SE_CD' AND CMMNS_CD_VALUE = G.TRMN_SE_CD) AS TRMN_SE_CD_NM-- 상태 , NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN J.ATNC_SE_CD IN ('01','03','04','05','07','08','09') THEN I.LCTRE_HR END),0) - TRUNC(COUNT(CASE WHEN J.ATNC_SE_CD IN ('03','04','05','07','08','09') THEN 1 END)/3)*MAX(I.LCTRE_HR) AS ATEND_TIMECNT --월별출석시간 , NVL(SUM(I.LCTRE_HR),0) AS CLASS_TIMECNT --월별총수업시간 , A.SRVC_PVSN_NO -- 서비스제공번호 , A.CASE_MNG_NO -- 사례관리번호 , A.CASE_MNG_ODRNO -- 사례관리차수 , A.RESRCE_NO -- 자원번호 FROM SEB510 A /*서비스제공대상자*/ JOIN SEB500 B /*서비스제공*/ ON B.SRVC_PVSN_NO = A.SRVC_PVSN_NO AND B.RESRCE_NO = A.RESRCE_NO AND B.DEL_YN = 'N' JOIN SDA100 C /*자원기본*/ ON C.RESRCE_NO = B.RESRCE_NO AND C.SRVC_RESRCE_LCLAS_SE_CD != '01' AND C.APRV_STTS_SE_CD = '2' JOIN SAA000 D /*통합기관*/ ON D.INST_NO = C.RSFR_INST_NO AND D.DEL_YN = 'N' AND D.APRV_YN = 'Y' AND D.UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD = #{UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD} JOIN SEB100 E /*사례기본*/ ON E.CASE_MNG_NO = A.CASE_MNG_NO AND E.CASE_MNG_ODRNO = A.CASE_MNG_ODRNO JOIN SEA200 F /*대상자정보*/ ON F.TRPR_INFO_NO = E.TRPR_INFO_NO AND F.DEL_YN = 'N' LEFT JOIN ( SELECT G1.* , ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY G1.CASE_MNG_NO, G1.CASE_MNG_ODRNO ORDER BY G1.CASE_TRMN_NO DESC) AS ROW_NUMBER FROM SEC100 G1 /*사례종결(신청)*/ JOIN SEC100 G2 /*사례종결(승인)*/ ON G2.CASE_MNG_NO = G1.CASE_MNG_NO AND G2.CASE_MNG_ODRNO = G2.CASE_MNG_ODRNO WHERE G2.TRMN_SRNG_RESULT_SE_CD = '02' AND G1.TRMN_SRNG_RESULT_SE_CD = '01' ) G ON G.CASE_MNG_NO = E.CASE_MNG_NO AND G.CASE_MNG_ODRNO = E.CASE_MNG_ODRNO AND G.ROW_NUMBER = 1 LEFT JOIN AFA330 H /*교육이수일정*/ ON H.CASE_MNG_NO = E.CASE_MNG_NO AND H.CASE_MNG_ODRNO = E.CASE_MNG_ODRNO LEFT JOIN ( SELECT I3.RESRCE_NO , I3.LCTRE_YMD , SUM(I3.LCTRE_HR) AS LCTRE_HR FROM SDA300 I1 /*자원프로그램*/ JOIN SDA340 I2 /*자원프로그램상세일정*/ ON I2.PROGRM_NO = I1.PROGRM_NO AND I2.RESRCE_NO = I1.RESRCE_NO JOIN SDA320 I3 /*자원프로그램실행시간*/ ON I3.PROGRM_NO = I2.PROGRM_NO AND I3.RESRCE_NO = I2.RESRCE_NO AND I3.LCTRE_SN = I2.LCTRE_SN WHERE I1.DEL_YN = 'N' AND I2.DEL_YN = 'N' GROUP BY I3.RESRCE_NO, I3.LCTRE_YMD ) I ON I.RESRCE_NO = C.RESRCE_NO AND I.LCTRE_YMD BETWEEN NVL(NVL(H.BGNG_YMD,E.CASE_BGNG_YMD),B.SRVC_PVSN_BGNG_YMD) AND NVL(NVL(H.END_YMD,E.CASE_TRMN_YMD),B.SRVC_PVSN_END_YMD) LEFT JOIN SEB530 J /*자원프로그램제공*/ ON J.SRVC_PVSN_NO = A.SRVC_PVSN_NO AND J.CASE_MNG_NO = A.CASE_MNG_NO AND J.CASE_MNG_ODRNO = A.CASE_MNG_ODRNO AND J.RESRCE_NO = A.RESRCE_NO AND J.PTCPTN_YMD = I.LCTRE_YMD AND J.PROGRM_CRSE_SE_CD = '1' WHERE 1=1 AND (SELECT BIZ_YR FROM SDA400 /*서비스사업*/ WHERE SRVC_BIZ_NO = (SELECT SRVC_BIZ_NO FROM SDA420 /*서비스실행사업*/ WHERE SRVC_EXCN_BIZ_NO = C.SRVC_EXCN_BIZ_NO)) = #{BIZ_YR} -- 사업연도 AND D.INST_NO = #{INST_NO} -- 기관번호
AND C.RESRCE_NO = #{RESRCE_NO} -- 자원번호
AND F.TRPR_NM_ENCPT = ENC_B64(#{TRPR_NM}) -- 대상자명[암호화]
AND A.DEL_YN = 'N' AND D.INST_NO IN (SELECT PIC_INST_NO FROM SEB150 /*사례담당자*/ WHERE CASE_MNG_NO = E.CASE_MNG_NO AND CASE_MNG_ODRNO = E.CASE_MNG_ODRNO) GROUP BY D.INST_NM , C.PVSN_RESRCE_NM , F.TRPR_NM_ENCPT , F.TRPR_INFO_NO , G.TRMN_SE_CD , A.SRVC_PVSN_NO , A.CASE_MNG_NO , A.CASE_MNG_ODRNO , A.RESRCE_NO , SUBSTR(I.LCTRE_YMD,1,6) ) GROUP BY INST_NM , PVSN_RESRCE_NM , TRPR_NM , TRPR_INFO_NO , TRMN_SE_CD_NM , SRVC_PVSN_NO , CASE_MNG_NO , CASE_MNG_ODRNO , RESRCE_NO ORDER BY PVSN_RESRCE_NM, TRPR_NM
